title: 第3章 绿茶婊苏薇第4章 大丈夫何患无妻
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第3章绿茶婊苏薇
半条街安静了，
这两记耳光，不光把这两人打的昏死过去，
也把在场所有人都打懵了，
想象中江尘惨死的场景没有出现，
反而是这两个凝气期的人被一招重伤，
“发生了什么？江尘不是还没凝气吗，怎么赢的他们俩？”
“这个废物...不是不是...这个江尘到底怎么过去的，你有没有看清他的动作？”
“没有啊，一眨眼的功夫，这俩人就被抽晕了，你看这脸烂的，这一巴掌，起码几千斤的力量！”
众人集体瞠目，一时间思维直接卡住了，
本来狞笑着准备看江尘重伤的江峰也呆滞当场，
这个傻子...
不！
他不傻了！
在万兽山脉究竟发生了什么！
难道他获得了什么逆天机缘？
江尘一幅漫不经心的表情，似乎刚才那两巴掌并不是他打的，
江峰的惊讶也只是一闪而逝，眼神变得凶戾，
“没想到，你还真有两下子，不如，咱们兄弟切磋切磋？”
“好啊，都说你是武道天才，我还真想领教一番。”

江尘眼中亦有战意，
自己虽未凝气，却已有万斤巨力，加上昨日吞噬了数头妖兽的神通，
他想试试，与这个传说中的江家天才到底有多大的差距，
听到两人的交谈，围观的人已经有些呆滞，
这还是那个废物江尘吗，
两巴掌抽晕了两个凝气重的武者，
听这意思，
他竟然还敢向江峰发起挑战！
难道，这个废物之前都是装的，都在韬光养晦？
江峰被江尘的话逗笑了，
自以为赢两个蚂蚁，就妄图挑战雄狮？
“江尘，哈哈...哈哈哈！
就凭你，也敢向我发起挑战？我不知道你有什么奇遇，但你我资质天渊之别，这是一出生便决定了的，命中注定，我是你一生需要仰视的存在，或许这些年我对你太过仁慈了，让你误以为我与你在一个世界！”
“你废话说完了吗？”
江尘冷冷开口，
江峰面露狰狞，这个废物，竟然再三挑衅自己，
他决定不再留手，一脸蔑视道：
“一招，只需一招，便让你知道你我的差距！”
江峰骤然发动，经脉真元流转，右拳之上闪现一道淡淡白光，
如闪电直轰向江尘胸口，

虽然动作不大，但力有万钧！
江尘竟是不避，一拳掠起残影，带出刺耳风声，
竟敢和江峰硬碰硬？
江海满脸惊恐，周围的街坊也眼露惊色，
content_en:
Chapter 3 Green Tea Bitch Su Wei
Half of the street was quiet.
These two slaps not only knocked these two people unconscious, but also knocked them unconscious.
It also stunned everyone present.
The imagined scene of Jiang Chen's tragic death did not appear.
Instead, these two people in the Qi Condensation stage were seriously injured by one move.
"What happened? Jiang Chen hasn't condensed his Qi yet, so how could he win against the two of them?"
"This waste...no, no...how did this Jiang Chen get there? Did you see his movements clearly?"
"No, in the blink of an eye, these two people were knocked unconscious. Look at their rotten faces. This slap must have a force of at least several thousand kilograms!"
Everyone stared in amazement, and their thoughts were immediately stuck.
Jiang Feng, who was originally smiling ferociously and preparing to see Jiang Chen seriously injured, was also stunned on the spot.
This fool...
No!
He is no longer stupid!
What happened in the Ten Thousand Beasts Mountains!
Did he get some incredible opportunity?
Jiang Chen looked careless, as if the two slaps just now were not from him.
Jiang Feng's surprise only faded away for a moment, and his eyes became fierce.
"I didn't expect that you really have two ideas. How about we brothers compete and learn from each other?"
"Okay, everyone says you are a martial arts genius, and I really want to learn from you."
Jiang Chen also had a fighting spirit in his eyes.
Although he has not yet condensed his Qi, he already has tens of thousands of kilograms of strength. In addition, he has the magical power to swallow several demonic beasts yesterday.
He wanted to try to see how far he was from the legendary genius of the Jiang family.
After hearing the conversation between the two, the onlookers were a little stunned.
Is this still the good-for-nothing Jiang Chen?
Two slaps knocked the two warriors with strong energy unconscious.
Listen to this,
He actually dared to challenge Jiang Feng!
Could it be that this good-for-nothing was just pretending and hiding his capabilities and biding his time?
Jiang Feng was amused by Jiang Chen's words,
Thinking that you have defeated two ants, you try to challenge the lion?
"Jiang Chen, haha...hahaha!
You alone dare to challenge me? I don’t know what adventures you have had, but there is a huge difference in your qualifications and mine. This was determined at birth. It is destined that I am the existence you need to look up to throughout your life. Maybe I have been too kind to you over the years, making you mistakenly think that I am in the same world as you! "
"Are you done talking nonsense?"
Jiang Chen said coldly,
Jiang Feng looked ferocious. This loser actually provoked him again and again.
He decided not to hold back any more and said with contempt:
"One move, just one move, will let you know the difference between you and me!"
Jiang Feng suddenly activated, the true energy in his meridians flowed, and a faint white light flashed above his right fist.
Like lightning hitting Jiang Chen's chest,
Although the movement is not big, it is powerful!
Jiang Chen didn't avoid it, he punched up the residual image, bringing out the harsh sound of wind,
How dare you confront Jiang Feng head-on?
Jiang Hai's face was full of horror, and the eyes of the surrounding neighbors were also shocked.
